verdict_note: The drawing did not pass the gate. Redraw it and send it again.

mandates.text: Continuous exterior insulation on all opaque walls and roof edges; no uninsulated parapets.
Exposed sheet metal is prefinished aluminium, colour to match window frames.
No exposed sealant as the primary line of water defence.

reasons: Not one material is tagged. The only notes are "flashing??" and "typ.", which name nothing.
Lines do not close into shapes, so wall, roof and flashing cannot be told apart.
There is nothing here to check a rulebook against. Reviewing it would mean guessing.
missing: any closed shape that reads as a material

qc_list.item: Coping or cap slopes back to the roof side and has a drip edge clear of both wall faces.
qc_list.why: A flat or outward-sloping cap holds water and stains or wets the facade.

qc_list.item: Roof membrane base flashing turns up the parapet at least 8 in (200 mm) above the finished roof surface and is terminated and counter-flashed.
qc_list.why: Low or unterminated base flashing is the most common parapet leak.

qc_list.item: A continuous membrane or sheet-metal underlayment runs over the top of the parapet, under the coping, lapped onto both faces.
qc_list.why: Coping joints leak; the layer below is what keeps water out of the wall.

qc_list.item: Air and water barrier of the wall is shown continuous with the roof membrane across the parapet.
qc_list.why: A break here lets interior air into the parapet, where it condenses.

qc_list.item: Continuous insulation wraps the parapet or the thermal break at the roof-to-wall line is shown; R-value meets the energy code for the project climate zone.
qc_list.why: An uninsulated parapet is a thermal bridge around the whole roof.

qc_list.item: Cant or tapered edge, fastening of the coping (continuous cleat) and the wood blocking are labelled, with a scale and material tags.
qc_list.why: The builder needs these to price and build it; missing labels become RFIs.

qc_list.item: Parapet bracing or reinforcing is shown or referenced to structural where the building is in a high seismic design category.
qc_list.why: Unbraced parapets are a falling hazard in an earthquake.

qc_list.item: Project mandate: Continuous exterior insulation on all opaque walls and roof edges; no uninsulated parapets.
Project mandate: Exposed sheet metal is prefinished aluminium, colour to match window frames.
Project mandate: No exposed sealant as the primary line of water defence.
Lesson learned: Coping joints opened after two winters where no membrane ran under the cap. Always draw the under-coping membrane and tag it.
Lesson learned: Parapets under 12 in high leave no room for an 8 in base flashing plus counter-flashing. Check the parapet height against the tapered insulation high point.
Lesson learned: Details issued without a scale or material tags produced the most RFIs. Tag every hatch.
